description: This file is the Bootstrap.php source file for the HTMLPurifier library, containing the HTMLPurifier_Bootstrap class that provides autoloading functionalities and setup for the HTML Purifier project.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Bootstrap
classes.description: A class providing autoloading and path resolution functionalities for the HTML Purifier library.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Autoloads a class file based on the class name.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Resolves the filesystem path for a given class name within the HTML Purifier namespace.

methods.name: registerAutoload
methods.description: Registers the autoload function with PHP's SPL autoload stack.
